entry_points.summary: Cheap parallel pre-plan ideation with conversational discussion/selection tail. Phase 0: sharpen-vs-skip gate (D5) auto-invokes /z-sharpen inline when topic is vague; NL count parse extracts WIDE_N from prose (default 3); scope probe (LIGHT/MEDIUM/HEAVY); wide×HEAVY suppression (D2). Phase 2a: persona draw (brainstorm.personas knob). Phase 2b: 3 vendor-diverse ideators (Claude+Codex+Gemini). Phase 2c (WIDE_N>3): conversational cost gate (end-turn, not AskUserQuestion), overflow waves, ideator-clusterer collapse N→K. Phase 3: ranked prose briefing + hard end-turn invariant. Phase 4 LIGHT/MEDIUM: discussion loop; Phase 4 HEAVY: chunk×framing ranked briefing. Re-spin machinery shared helper (cap 3 waves). Writes BRAINSTORM.md; chosen_framing updated on unambiguous lock-in.

Separate check before scope-probe. Check 1: GRILL.md already exists → skip. Check 2: heuristic (≥40 chars + concrete markers → skip; <15 chars → sharpen). Check 3: one Haiku call for grey-zone topics; parse failure → skip (conservative default). Decision: skip → proceed to scope-probe; sharpen → auto-invoke z-sharpen inline (produces GRILL.md), then proceed; user abandon during sharpen treated as skip. Emits sharpen_gate {decision, reason, grill_md_existed}.

Parse desired ideator count N from NL topic. No --wide flag. Patterns: '<N> ways/options/ideas', 'brainstorm <N>', lots-of/many/wide/mega → 6. Cap at 20. Default N=3. Emits count_parsed {wide_n, default_used}. D2: if WIDE_N>3 and scope=HEAVY, suppresses HEAVY fanout → MODE=MEDIUM.

Assembles identical payload for all ideators. 1a: doc-fetcher (Haiku) if INDEX.json exists. 1b: optional Explore (Haiku) if Z_HARNESS_BRAINSTORM_EXPLORE=1. 1c: MAP.md ingestion (falls back to RESEARCH.md with artifact_kind=map; skips artifact_kind=approach_synthesis). 1c-ii: GRILL.md seed framing injected if present (## Sharpened problem + ## Open branches). 1d: input_hash sha256 of topic+doc_fetcher+explore+research+grill_seed. Checkpoint: archive/RUN/phase1-scaffolding.md.

2a: persona draw (brainstorm.personas knob; graceful degradation on pool underflow). 2b: 3 vendor-diverse ideators in parallel (Claude general-purpose Sonnet, Codex consultant-secondary, Gemini consultant-primary), identical scaffolding + IDEATOR_SCHEMA (5-section). Failure policy: 1/3 → proceed; 2/3 → AskUser (retry/proceed-with-1/abandon); 3/3 → hard halt. Emits ideator_failed, total_ideator_failure, persona_bound.

Overflow model resolution: prompt override > brainstorm.wide_overflow_model config > haiku default; cheap-mixed gated/no-op (M2 constraint, no --model path for codex-cli/agy). Conversational cost gate: end-turn, NOT AskUserQuestion; HARD INVARIANT no ideators until user confirms. Wave 1: existing Phase 2b dispatch. Overflow waves 2+: round-robin vendor pairs (wave1=Claude+Codex, wave2=Claude+Gemini, wave3=Codex+Gemini) via re-spin machinery with anti-seed divergence. Cap: max 3 overflow waves (N>9 capped at 9, user informed). After all waves: ideator-clusterer (Haiku) collapses N framings → K clusters.

Parse all ideator returns. Anti-bias check (mandatory): every Claude-favoring pick needs explicit justification. Orchestrator recommendation with one-line rationale. Writes BRAINSTORM.md with YAML frontmatter (chosen_framing: pending; ideator_personas always written). Produces ranked prose briefing inline. HARD INVARIANT: must end the turn — no AskUserQuestion, no further tool call. Wide mode: presents K cluster directions from ideator-clusterer, not N raw framings; cross-cluster consensus surfaced as callout.

Fires when mode=HEAVY. 4H-1: parse unified BRAINSTORM.md chunk×framing matrix (skips FAILED chunks). 4H-2: ranked pair briefing inline + end-turn (NOT AskUserQuestion). 4H-3: discussion loop; lock-in writes chosen_pair {chunk_id, framing} and appends ## User choice verbatim; abandon sets chosen_framing: abandoned (no chosen_pair). Emits heavy_pair_selected. Falls through to 'In all branches' for run-brief finalize + brainstorm_run_end.

Interprets user's free-text reply. Supported intents: ask (answer+re-present), challenge/narrow (discuss; optional re-spin), combine X+Y (draft synthesized framing + await confirm), re-spin (cap 3 via re-spin machinery), lock-in (write chosen_framing + ## User choice verbatim), restart (archive + conversational refined-topic ask), abandon (status=abandoned, chosen_framing=abandoned). HARD INVARIANT: write chosen_framing ONLY on unambiguous lock-in. synthesized is the default/expected outcome for discussion-born hybrids.

Shared helper used by Phase 4 LIGHT/MEDIUM loop and wide-mode overflow. Cap: 3 waves max (fully-failed wave does not consume cap slot). Subset selection deterministic by wave: wave1=Claude+Codex, wave2=Claude+Gemini, wave3=Codex+Gemini. Anti-seed prompt includes prior framings + divergence instruction. Cost note emitted inline before dispatch. Appends ## Re-spin wave N to BRAINSTORM.md (append-only, never rewrites). Emits respin_wave event.

Haiku subagent for wide /z-brainstorm (WIDE_N>3). Reads N ideator framing blocks from BRAINSTORM.md, clusters by approach axis into K distinct directions. Returns: K cluster labels + members + representative framing (verbatim), effective-diversity report (N→K, collapsed framings named, cross-cluster consensus). Read-only — no file writes. Caller (orchestrator) substitutes K clusters for N raw framings in Phase 3 ranked briefing; failure → fall back to N raw framings.

invariants: Phase 3 ranked briefing MUST end the turn — no AskUserQuestion, no further tool call; Phase 4 begins only from user's next natural-language reply (brainstorm tail never auto-decides, m5 load-bearing)
chosen_framing written ONLY on an unambiguous lock-in signal from the user; ambiguous reply → clarifying question, never a write
synthesized is the default/expected chosen_framing for a discussion-born hybrid; single-vendor pick still allowed
Wide (WIDE_N>3) and HEAVY fan-outs never multiply (D2): explicit wide-N request suppresses HEAVY chunk fanout, treats as MEDIUM; emits wide_suppressed_heavy event
Wide cost gate is conversational (end-turn), NOT AskUserQuestion; HARD INVARIANT: no ideators dispatched until user confirms
Wide overflow cap: max 3 overflow waves (N≤9 covered); WIDE_N>9 → inform user, cap at N=9
OVERFLOW_MODEL applies only to general-purpose (Claude) overflow slots; consultant arms (codex/gemini) run at native defaults (M2 constraint)
cheap-mixed overflow model is gated/no-op: no --model path verified for codex-cli or agy; fallback is haiku; warn inline when config requests cheap-mixed
Re-spin discussion-loop cap: 3 waves max; fully-failed wave (2/2 fail) does NOT consume a cap slot
ideator-clusterer dispatched after all wide-mode waves complete; K=0 or failure → fall back to N raw framings in ranked briefing
Phase 0 sharpen gate is a separate cheap check, NOT folded into scope-probe; idea vagueness ≠ codebase fanout size
Sharpen gate: skip → proceed; sharpen → run z-sharpen inline (produces GRILL.md), then proceed; user abandon during sharpen treated as skip (continue without GRILL.md)
Sharpen gate heuristic parse failure → skip (conservative: never force sharpening on bad parse)
GRILL.md seed framing (Phase 1c-ii): if present, ## Sharpened problem + ## Open branches injected into scaffolding payload; GRILL.md content included in input_hash
BRAINSTORM.md ## User choice section appended only on first convergence; Phase 3 writes chosen_framing: pending (no placeholder ## User choice)
For synthesized chosen_framing: ## User choice must contain the FULL co-authored hybrid text (all 5 sections) so /z-plan has a complete seed
HEAVY abandon: chosen_framing=abandoned, no chosen_pair key; uniform with LIGHT/MEDIUM abandon shape
ask_user stays in driver_features_required; only 3 selection gates converted to conversational; finite control-flow forks remain structured AskUserQuestion
Sub-flows in HEAVY fanout skip Phase 0 entirely (anti-sprawl: sub-flows never go HEAVY themselves)
ideator_personas frontmatter always written in Phase 3 even when brainstorm.personas=OFF or ideator failed
gotchas: Phase 3 briefing hard invariant: after writing BRAINSTORM.md and producing the briefing, orchestrator MUST NOT call any tool — not even Read — until user replies in Phase 4
wide_overflow_model=cheap-mixed is reserved but no-op; fallback to haiku + warn inline; do not silently proceed with cheap-mixed
Re-spin machinery appends new framings under wave headers (BRAINSTORM.md is append-only after Phase 3 write); never overwrites existing framing blocks
Wide mode: CLUSTER_BLOCKS from ideator-clusterer substitute for raw framings in ranked briefing; clusterer K=0 or error → silently fall back to N raw framings
WIDE_N>3 but scope=HEAVY: D2 suppression fires, MODE→MEDIUM, wide_suppressed_heavy emitted; HEAVY fan-out entirely skipped
Phase 4 LIGHT/MEDIUM ambiguity guardrail: if user reply could mean two things, ask clarifying question conversationally before writing BRAINSTORM.md — never guess
Phase 4 HEAVY: chosen_pair NOT written until both chunk and framing are unambiguously identified in user's reply
MAP.md takes precedence over RESEARCH.md as terrain artifact; RESEARCH.md with artifact_kind=approach_synthesis is explicitly skipped (not brainstorm scaffolding)
Parent attribution: when Z_HARNESS_PARENT_RUN_ID is set (e.g. dispatched by /z-research), include parent_run_id + parent_command in every log-event payload
Cost guardrail: target ≤200K tokens end-to-end; exceeding logs a warning event but does not halt
